method.scope: Matched, indexed regional queries of the four RNA products already identified in additional_candidate_audit.json; this is a targeted audit, not a sensitivity benchmark or de novo variant call set.
method.ktn1: Isovar 1.17.0 default read collection and translation with overlap assembly on/off and balanced/context/support preferences. All modes agreed within each platform.
method.structural_variants: Primary alignments were checked for exact breakpoint-spanning CIGAR or reciprocal-SA evidence and for annotated transcript splice junctions. Fragment counts deduplicate query name and mate identity.
method.comparison_limit: ONT single-cell and Illumina bulk libraries differ in preparation, depth, and deduplication. Counts support within-product sequence claims and must not be interpreted as platform sensitivity or abundance comparisons.

records.conclusion: Both platforms encode the same FYSLL mutant tail and the same 20 mutation-overlapping 8-11mers; ONT alone supplies enough upstream context for a 25-aa construct.
records.dna_model: chr14:g.55627965_55627966insTT; Ensembl 87 maps the insertion to the shared coding frame of six KTN1 transcripts and predicts p.Leu340fs with a five-residue FYSLL tail before stop.
records.vaccine_impact: The antigen sequence is concordant, not platform-specific. The platform effect is construct eligibility: ONT yields five mutation-overlapping 25mers, while the 18-aa Illumina context yields none.

overview.long: 10 ALT fragments; 29-aa protein context; five 25-aa windows
overview.short: 4 ALT reads / 2 fragments; 18-aa context; no 25-aa window
overview.vaccine: Same 20 class-I 8-11mers; ONT enables the long construct

rows.label: T2 Oxford Nanopore RNA
rows.evidence: 10 exact ALT fragments; nine support the selected translation. Assembly on/off and all three preference modes agree.

rows.label: T2 Illumina RNA
rows.evidence: Four exact ALT reads in two fragments; both fragments support the selected translation. Assembly does not extend it.
rows.peptide_pool: Same 20 unique mutation-overlapping 8-11mers; 0 eligible 25-aa construct windows

records.conclusion: Long and short RNA both show canonical DLG5 expression from an intact transcript, but neither contains the somatic deletion junction; no mutant CDS or vaccine peptide is established.
records.dna_model: The 79,531-bp deletion removes five ENST00000372391 coding exons, including the chr10:77926518-77926520 start codon. The retained lower-coordinate coding region has no annotated start after the deletion.
records.vaccine_impact: ONT phases up to four canonical DLG5 exon junctions on single reads; Illumina supplies many local junction fragments. Both observations describe reference-spliced RNA, not the deletion allele, so both peptide pools remain empty.

overview.long: Two T1 and two T2 reads phase four canonical DLG5 junctions
overview.short: Canonical retained-to-deleted exon junction: 130 T1 / 51 T2 fragments
overview.vaccine: No deletion-junction RNA on either platform; no mutant peptide

rows.label: T1/T2 Oxford Nanopore RNA
rows.evidence: No deletion-junction path. Two reads in each sample span four canonical DLG5 exon junctions, linking retained and DNA-deleted regions on an intact RNA molecule.
rows.protein: Reference-spliced DLG5 only; mutant CDS not observed

rows.label: T1/T2 Illumina RNA
rows.evidence: No deletion-junction fragment. The canonical 77843706|77853354 splice has 130 T1 and 51 T2 primary fragments, but short reads do not phase the full exon chain.
rows.transcript_nt: WT local junction: ...77843706|77853354...; deletion junction 77850921|77930452 not observed
rows.protein: Reference-spliced DLG5 only; mutant CDS not observed

records.conclusion: Both platforms recover the same canonical coding splice across the affected intron; the 128-bp DNA deletion is absent from mature coding RNA and creates no observed peptide difference.
records.dna_model: chr2:99668095-99668223 lies wholly inside the intron between ENST00000317233 exons ending at 99649666 and starting at 99672538; no Ensembl 87 coding exon overlaps it.
records.vaccine_impact: The mature coding junction is identical with or without the intronic DNA segment. ONT adds long-range isoform linkage, while Illumina confirms the local splice; neither supplies a mutant coding sequence to rank.

overview.short: Same canonical junction: 26 T1 / 15 T2 fragments
overview.vaccine: No coding-sequence change on either platform; no mutant peptide

rows.label: T1/T2 Oxford Nanopore RNA
rows.evidence: Six T1 and 16 T2 primary fragments carry the canonical coding splice; long reads continue across additional AFF3 exons on the same molecule.
rows.transcript_nt: Coding path: exon ...99649626-99649666 | 99672538-99672589...; deleted DNA 99668095-99668223 is intronic and absent
rows.protein: Canonical AFF3 protein sequence; no mutant translation

rows.label: T1/T2 Illumina RNA
rows.evidence: Twenty-six T1 and 15 T2 primary fragments carry the same canonical coding splice; no exact DNA-deletion junction or altered exon boundary is observed.
rows.transcript_nt: Same mature junction: ...99649666|99672538...; intronic 128 bp is absent through ordinary splicing
rows.protein: Canonical AFF3 protein sequence; no mutant translation

records.conclusion: Both platforms strongly support the unchanged KEAP1 coding splice. Illumina alone samples a noncoding processed isoform that overlaps the DNA deletion, but no complete mutant RNA path is observed.
records.dna_model: chr19:10492683-10492894 is intronic in every inspected Ensembl 87 coding transcript. It removes 35 nt from an exon of noncoding processed transcript ENST00000588024, which has no CDS.
records.vaccine_impact: The platform difference concerns noncoding isoform detection, not an antigen. ONT and Illumina agree on the canonical coding RNA; neither produces an altered coding frame or variant-specific peptide.

overview.long: Canonical coding splice: 473 T1 / 535 T2; no processed-isoform junction
overview.short: Coding splice: 98 T1 / 63 T2; noncoding isoform complete only in T1
overview.vaccine: Platform-specific noncoding evidence; coding peptide set unchanged

rows.label: T1/T2 Oxford Nanopore RNA
rows.evidence: The canonical coding 10492262|10499395 splice has 473 T1 and 535 T2 primary fragments. Neither processed-transcript junction is observed.
rows.transcript_nt: Coding path: ...10492262|10499395...; deleted DNA is intronic. ENST00000588024 exon path not detected
rows.protein: Canonical KEAP1 coding protein; no mutant translation

rows.label: T1/T2 Illumina RNA
rows.evidence: The coding splice has 98 T1 and 63 T2 fragments. T1 also supports both noncoding isoform junctions (4 and 6); T2 supports only the upstream junction (2).
rows.protein: Canonical coding protein; processed transcript has no CDS
